title: DesignRevision
description: An immutable snapshot of one design (blueprint §3.2). Any edit creates a new revision with a new revision_id and parent_revision_id pointing back; the old one becomes SUPERSEDED if it had passed. Downstream previews, cut plans, DIY steps and briefs reference exactly one revision and are invalid for any other. status is set only by the feasibility engine.

parent_revision_id.description: Revision this one was derived from; null for the first revision of a design.

inputs_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of `inputs` + recipe_id + recipe_version + parameters. Equal hashes mean equal check inputs.

recipe_id.description: null only for IDEA_ONLY revisions with no matching reviewed recipe.

geometry_mm.description: Derived dimensions computed by the feasibility engine from the recipe, parameters and measurements, e.g. finished_length_mm, hem_allowance_mm, cut_mark_from_shoulder_mm. Every key ends in _mm. Empty when the engine could not compute geometry.

stale.description: true when this revision's inputs.measurements_id is no longer the project's current measurements_id, so its check ran on replaced values. Computed by the API at read time: it is not a design state, never changes status, and is not stored on the immutable revision or part of inputs_hash. While true, clients must not offer the result as current: show the recheck first and do not present the cut mark, geometry_mm or a cut guide as ready to use. Recheck with POST /v1/designs/{design_id}/revisions and empty parameters.

diy_suitability.description: User-specific DIY recommendation, separate from physical feasibility. null when no recipe applies.

pending_checks.description: Checks the user must still do in person before cutting (e.g. verify collar-to-hem reference with a ruler).

cut_plan_id.description: Present only for PASS_SUPPORTED_CHECKS (or a SUPERSEDED revision that had passed).

InputsSnapshot.description: Exactly what the engine checked, so the result can be reproduced.

PreviewRef.description: Visual concept for this revision. Always approximate; never evidence that the design can be cut.

RevisionCreate.description: Body of POST /v1/designs/{design_id}/revisions. The server copies the parent, applies the changed parameters, reruns the feasibility engine and returns a new revision. The parent is never modified, apart from being marked SUPERSEDED when it had passed.

parameters.description: Parameters to change. Keys must be in the recipe's allow-list. Empty means recheck the parent's parameters against the current measurements (the recovery for a stale revision); use a new Idempotency-Key.
